messages:
devops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: spike in 502/503 errors for /v1/generate across us-east-1 clusters. Paging on-call.
sam (oncall): I'm on it. seeing elevated 5xx rate ~12% for the last 2m. rerouting healthy pool now.
meera (eng): thanks. are we seeing model-specific failures or gateway timeouts?
sam (oncall): mostly gateway 502s, some downstream model pods returning 500. starting a rolling restart of the gateway replicas.
jordan (ops): I'll pre-draft a status page initial message. want to confirm scope: partial degradation for text generation in us-east-1, some customers affected, short term mitigation in progress.
carla (support): heads up — we've started collecting customer reports. a couple enterprise tenants in prod reported errors around 14:03 UTC. CS is ready to send targeted notes once we have wording.
emily (customer success): pls include wording about data safety and no data loss. cc legal for any PII concerns.
meera (eng): root cause hypothesis: a recent autoscaling change for the KV cache caused GC storms on a subset of inference nodes. reverting scaling policy now.
sam (oncall): rollback applied to autoscaling policy at 14:05 UTC. observing drop in 5xx after 30s, but still noisy.
jordan (ops): DRAFT status page (initial): ```We are investigating increased errors for text generation in us-east-1 causing some requests to fail with 5xx errors. Engineers are actively investigating and mitigation is in progress. Affected customers may see errors or increased latency. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes.```
carla (support): looks good. suggest adding: "No evidence of data loss. If you see 5xx please retry; we recommend exponential backoff." Also add ETA for next update: +15m.
emily (customer success): +1 on retry guidance and reassurance.
legal-bot: Quick note: avoid promising timelines or root cause until confirmed. "Investigating" + "mitigation in progress" is fine.
jordan (ops): updated draft incorporating edit: ```We are investigating increased 5xx errors for text generation in us-east-1 impacting some customers. Engineers are mitigating; no evidence of data loss. Please retry failed requests. Next update in 15 minutes.``` Ready to publish after internal sign-off.
meera (eng): current metrics: 5xx down from 12% to 4% in last 2m. KV cache rollback seems to be helping. still monitoring.
sam (oncall): I'm going to hold publishing initial status page until we confirm a short mitigation window. but we should queue it — Carlie (support) can notify affected customers once live.
carla (support): I'll prepare targeted customer note once published. draft template: ```Hello — we detected intermittent 5xx errors affecting text generation in us-east-1 between 14:00–14:10 UTC. We've mitigations in place and recommend retrying. We're monitoring and will update at 14:20 UTC.```
emily (customer success): good. include our support contact and a link to incident updates.
jordan (ops): publishing now.
devops-bot: Status page publish: initial update posted at 14:08 UTC. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2499990000
sam (oncall): thanks. continuing to watch metrics. will post 15m update at 14:23 UTC unless situation changes.
meera (eng): 14:15 metrics: 5xx ~1.2% — nearly baseline. rolling restarts completed. recommending to change status to "partial degradation — mitigated" on next update if stable.
jordan (ops): UPDATE DRAFT: ```Issue mitigated — we observed reduced errors after a rollback of a scaling policy and rolling restarts. Users may experience residual errors; we continue to monitor. No evidence of data loss.```
carla (support): approved. ready to send targeted customer notices referencing the status page.
legal-bot: Approved wording. avoid attributing to a configuration change; keep as mitigation.
sam (oncall): marking as monitored. scheduled resolved notice if metrics remain stable for 10m.
meera (eng): metrics stable for 10m now. 5xx at 0.2%.
jordan (ops): RESOLVED DRAFT: ```Resolved — The issue affecting text generation in us-east-1 has been resolved as of 14:32 UTC. We conducted a rollback and completed restarts; normal service has resumed. If you continue to experience problems, contact support. Thank you for your patience.``` Publishing final now.
devops-bot: Status page update: resolved posted at 14:33 UTC. Incident closed. Incident link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2499990000
carla (support): sending customer follow-ups now. ticketing notes attached.
emily (customer success): good job team. can we add a short replay/mechanism summary for postmortem? sam/meera — please add timeline to the incident doc.
sam (oncall): noted — will add timeline and commands executed.
meera (eng): will add root cause analysis draft and mitigation plan.
jordan (ops): closing thread. :white_check_mark:
